## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre completed 47 captures during March 2021. Activity proceeded in accordance with the site’s usual arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the site maintained regular service delivery throughout the month.

## Image quality

Image quality was reviewed as part of the routine process. A total of 6 captures were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 12.8. These images could not be used for a conclusive assessment and should be considered in the ongoing review of capture quality and staff practice. The result provides a basis for monitoring image quality in subsequent reporting periods.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results. These cases should continue through the appropriate referral pathway in line with established arrangements. The median wait from capture to grading was recorded as 1 days. Overall, the grading activity reflects the work completed from the month’s captures and provides a summary of the outcomes requiring further clinical attention.
